fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id,
  (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 1000003 % 2000000011 - 1000000005)::BIGINT * 1000 END) AS big,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 37 % 255 - 127) END)::BIGINT AS b8,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 211 % 65535 - 32767) END)::BIGINT AS b16,
  (CASE WHEN k % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 100003 % 4000000000 - 2000000000) END)::BIGINT AS b32,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 401 - 200) * 0.25) END)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS d2,
  (CASE WHEN k % 8 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 241 - 120) * 0.5) END)::DECIMAL(4,1) AS d4,
  (CASE WHEN k % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 7919 % 1000000007) - 500000003) * 0.000000001::DECIMAL(10,9) END)::DECIMAL(18,9) AS d9,
  (CASE WHEN k % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 1234567891011 % 100000000000000) * 0.0000000001::DECIMAL(11,10) END)::DECIMAL(38,10) AS d38,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 401 - 200) * 0.25) END)::DOUBLE AS f,
  (CASE WHEN k % 14 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 97 - 48) / 8.0) END)::DOUBLE AS fr,
  ((k + 1) * 1e17)::DOUBLE AS fbig,
  (CASE WHEN k % 15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE make_timestamp((-300000000000000 + k * 337123456789)::BIGINT) END) AS ts,
  'v' || k::VARCHAR AS s,
  (k % 5)::INTEGER AS g
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)
